{{Quote|Although I should be leading the search for those Rebel scum, my superiors have decided that I should curb smuggling activity on Talus. A Kowakian monkey-lizard could perform such a duty. But if they want smuggling curbed on this planet, then I shall give them what they want. You're a servant of the Empire. I call upon you to assist me in carrying out these orders. I need an informant arrested and brought back here for interrogation. Can the Empire count on you?|Xalox Guul|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Xalox Guul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was based out of the [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Xalox Guul was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
